steps.what: Show the stored fault on this electronics equipment.
Modify, maintain, or repair electronics equipment.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the fault note already written for this electronics equipment or system. The engineering technician modifies, maintains, or repairs it so it functions. The note does not hold the tool. A note with no fault id leaves the repair with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: A unit was marked repaired because a fault title existed, and the equipment had not been opened.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored fault can be opened. The repair still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A fault the note does not describe still has to be found on the equipment.
tasks.human_edge: The technician repairs the equipment. The note is not the repair.
tasks.altitude: Modification, maintenance, and repair stay with the technician. The stored fault is only visible.

reach.task: Hear that the equipment was repaired by this technician.
reach.learn: A fault title is not the repair.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored fault note is a lookup. It does not modify, maintain, or repair the equipment.
Marking a title as closed does not make the equipment function.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.
Fields: The fault id and the note already written. The screen does not mark the equipment repaired. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the fault note in the document store before the repair.
unknowns: Whether equipment faults and system faults share one note.
research_questions: Who confirms the fault note matches the unit now on the bench?

already_counted.description: Modifying, maintaining, and repairing the equipment stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop fault notes whose equipment record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still modifies, maintains, or repairs the electronics equipment or system. Only opening a fault note that was already written is removed. A fault title saves none of the repair.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Compile stored schematics, repairs, and corrective action records.
Check the compiled record and accept a complete version.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store holds the schematic, the installed equipment, the problem, the resources used, the repair, and the corrective action when those rows already exist. They are compiled into one record, and a missing repair id stops the compile. The engineering technician checks that the record documents what was done. Only the version the technician accepts is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A record listed a repair from another unit because the equipment id was copied without the repair note.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored rows can be compiled. The check that they belong together still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A problem that was never written down still has to be added by the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician accepts the record. The compile does not decide that it is complete.
tasks.altitude: The completeness check stays with the technician. The record is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Read a record this technician has accepted.
reach.learn: A compiled list is not the check.

evidence.claim: Compiling stored schematic, repair, and action rows is a copy of fields that already exist. It does not decide that the record is complete.
Filing a record before the technician accepts that version would store a history nobody checked.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The schematic id, equipment id, problem id, resource id, repair id, and action id already stored. A missing repair id stops the compile. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Compile only rows that already exist. Do not invent a repair or a corrective action.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
unknowns: Whether installation problems and operational problems share one record type.
research_questions: Who confirms a compiled repair belongs to this installed equipment?

already_counted.description: Checking that the compiled record is complete stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop compiled rows whose equipment record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: equipment id and the row ids the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still checks the record of schematics, installed equipment, problems, resources, repairs, and corrective action. Only compiling rows that were already stored, and filing the record already accepted, is removed. A missing repair id saves none of that check.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored malfunction and the replacement part on file.
Identify and resolve malfunctions, and procure replacement parts.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the malfunction note and any replacement part already on file. The engineering technician identifies and resolves the malfunction, working with the manufacturer or the field representative, and procures the part. The note does not place the order. A part that is not on file is not invented.
tasks.previous_blocker: A part was ordered from a title, and the malfunction had not been identified.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored malfunction can be opened. The identification, the resolution, and the procurement still belong to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A malfunction the note does not describe still has to be found with the representative.
tasks.human_edge: The technician identifies the fault and procures the part. The file is not that call.
tasks.altitude: The work with the manufacturer or field representative stays with the technician. The stored note is only visible.

reach.task: Buy a part this technician has identified.
reach.learn: A malfunction title is not the part.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored malfunction is a lookup. It does not identify the fault, resolve it, or procure a part.
A part number that is not already on file is not a part. The screen must not invent one.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The malfunction id and any replacement part id already stored. A missing part is not filled in. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the malfunction note. Do not order a part the note does not identify.
unknowns: Whether manufacturers and field representatives are stored on the malfunction.
research_questions: Who may procure a replacement part before the malfunction is identified?

already_counted.description: Identifying the malfunction, resolving it, and procuring the part stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop notes whose equipment record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still identifies and resolves the malfunction, still works with the manufacturer or field representative, and still procures the replacement part. Only opening a note that was already written is removed. A title saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the assigned installation or operation.
Supervise installation or operation of electronic equipment.

tasks.design: The {PROJECT} record shows who is assigned to this installation or operation. The engineering technician supervises the installation or operation of the electronic equipment or system. The assignment line is not supervision, and it is not a score of the crew. A list with no names leaves the supervision with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: An installation was marked supervised because a name was on the assignment, and nobody was on the floor.
tasks.enabler_now: The assignment can be opened. The supervision still has to happen.
tasks.still_hard: A problem the assignment does not mention still has to be seen on the floor.
tasks.human_edge: The technician supervises. The assignment is the list already stored.
tasks.altitude: Supervision stays with the technician. The assignment is visible and is not a score.

reach.task: Staff the installation this technician is supervising.
reach.learn: An assignment line is not supervision.

evidence.claim: Opening an assignment list is a lookup. It does not supervise an installation or an operation.
Scoring or ranking the crew from that list would be a decision about workers. This step does not do that.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The assignment id and the names already stored. The screen does not score the crew or mark the work supervised. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the assignment. Do not rank the people on it.
unknowns: Whether installation assignments and operation assignments share one list.
research_questions: Who must be present before an installation is called supervised?

already_counted.description: Supervising the installation or operation stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop assignments whose job record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still supervises the installation or operation of the electronic equipment or system. Only opening an assignment that was already stored is removed. The list is not a score, and it saves none of the supervision.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineering technician still repairs the equipment, still checks the compiled record, still works with the field representative, and still supervises the installation. A stored row can be opened. It does not make the call.
reach: Field representatives bring the part, and this job learns a part number is not the repair.
Installers take direction from this technician, and an assignment line is not supervision.
skills_to_grow: Repair from the fault and the equipment, not from a title.
Accept a compiled record only when each repair and problem is the one that happened.
Supervise the installation without scoring the crew.
role.ambitious_version: Repair, record checks, parts, and supervision stay with the technician. Stored rows only show what was already written.

job.title: Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technologists and Technicians
